_comment: Native 9:16 captures of the real game at 540x960 CSS @2x → 1080x1920. Safe-zone layout: top 380 px (hook band) and bottom 480 px (caption zone) left empty by injected spacers; the game lays itself out between. Audio is the engine's own generated synth (tapped in-page). Marks are seconds on each mp4's timeline.

v-fail-retry.note: L6: 5 of par 6 played, 4 moves burned with real drags → fail sheet (last block one drag from its gate) → Retry (costs nothing — lives are off by default) → the reference line → 1-star clear.

v-solve-l14.note: L14 fresh board held (the countdown beat), then the 5-move par line played as real drags → 3-star card.

v-asmr-l8.note: L8: six par drags in one take with the engine's exit whoosh chain, stars, then the 24★ sheet certification (Sepia draft) — audio is the game's generated synth.

v-legend-l3.note: Title block → How to play (animated corner-route demo, block/gate/stone/moves rows) → Back → L3 corner drag at 1.0× → 3-star card.

v-day1.note: Fresh save: title block (Level 1/40, Stars 0/120, no streak, no meta rows — staged disclosure) → Play → L1 ghost route → one drag out → 3-star card.

v-day7.note: Save built by the engine itself: 12 levels cleared over 7 simulated consecutive days (GE.now), so the streak, the Field Survey sheet and the 24★ certification are the engine's own bookkeeping; then title block → Play → L13 first two real drags.

v-chain-l31.note: L31, the approval chain: the 1→2→3 overview on load → an out-of-turn numbered block dragged to its own open gate, where it PARKS instead of leaving (one drag charged, the NEXT chip unchanged) → undo → the chain cleared in order at par.
